title: Hold working with children checks
what: Make sure people doing child-related work hold the state's working with children check (or equivalent).

sources.title: Worker Screening Act 2020 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 123(1) (authorised version 018, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not engage, or continue to engage, another person (the worker) in child-related work if— (a) the person knows the work is child-related work; and (b) the worker does not have a current WWC clearance;

assessment.summary: People doing child-related work need the state or territory's working with children check.

marks.reason: Checks and their renewal for staff and volunteers in child-related work.
A check from one state is generally not valid in another, so people working across borders need several.
